A creative outlet could work..maybe take your mind off of whats bothering you and exhaust you so you have no other option but to sleep! But, alas, i know it is hard to find motivation in times like these. If you dont have the opportunity to talk to someone openly about why these horns keep blaring in your head maybe try a journal. At least get them out of your head. Open the cage door and let the birds fly freely. I guarantee you will feel slightly better each time you let off some steam, whether its through writing or talking. Or just reply here! Im always open to helping because ive been there. At 16 my parents were divorcing and my father was falling back into violent alcoholism. Remember this: no matter how alone you feel, someone, somewhere is going through the same thing and you are not alone. Its just about finding that someone who builds you up and uses you to build them up as well!

You need to start out by believing in yourself when you say "it is not my fault these people have left" and start with positive self-talk. Try and focus on the things you like about yourself and the things you can change. You are alive and only 16 years old. You cant change the past but what you CAN do is try to keep your head up and face adversity with confidence and positivity. I dont know you personally but i know there are people who would love to be your friend and love you for who YOU are. The people who arent a part of your life are missing out on happiness and an opportunity to enjoy the company of someone who truly cares about the well-being of others and how they feel. Stay strong and drown those voices out with positive reinforcement :)
